# Adverse 'add' inputs all surface specific exit codes. Stable codes
# are the contract LLMs and shell pipelines rely on.

# No args at all → cobra's arg-count check (exit 2).
! exec reloop add
stderr 'Usage error.*requires at least'

# No schedule flag (but command provided) → exit 2 (usage).
! exec reloop add -- echo hi
stderr 'provide exactly one of --cron or --at'

# Both schedule flags → exit 2.
! exec reloop add --cron '@hourly' --at '+1h' -- echo hi
stderr 'provide exactly one of --cron or --at'

# Missing '--' → exit 2.
! exec reloop add --cron '@hourly' echo hi
stderr 'Usage error.*place the command'

# Usage errors must not create the data dir as a side effect.
! exists $XDG_DATA_HOME/reloop/reloop.db

# Garbage cron expression → exit 5 (precondition).
! exec reloop add --cron 'garbage' -- echo hi
stderr 'invalid cron'

# Empty cron reads as an unset flag → usage error, exit 2.
! exec reloop add --cron '' -- echo hi

# Past one-shot → exit 5.
! exec reloop add --at '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z' -- echo hi
stderr 'not in the future'

# Nonsense at value → exit 5.
! exec reloop add --at 'yesterday' -- echo hi
stderr 'invalid time'

# Negative day offset → exit 5.
! exec reloop add --at '+-1h' -- echo hi

# Empty command after '--' → exit 2 (usage).
! exec reloop add --cron '@hourly' -- ''
stderr 'empty command'

# Whitespace-only shell line → exit 2.
! exec reloop add --cron '@hourly' -- '   '
stderr 'empty command'

# Syntactically valid cron that matches no real day → exit 5.
! exec reloop add --cron '0 0 31 2 *' -- echo hi
stderr 'matches no future time'

# Day offsets past the RFC3339 ceiling (year 9999) → exit 5.
! exec reloop add --at '+999999999d' -- echo hi
stderr 'maximum schedulable time'

# 2^57+1 days: AddDate normalization would wrap this back inside the
# valid window; it must still be rejected → exit 5.
! exec reloop add --at '+144115188075855873d' -- echo hi
stderr 'maximum schedulable time'

# Sub-second @every would be silently rounded up to 1s → exit 5.
! exec reloop add --cron '@every 500ms' -- echo hi
stderr 'at least 1s'

# Sub-second --at offsets lose the race against the store's clock → exit 5.
! exec reloop add --at '+500ms' -- echo hi
stderr 'at least 1s'

# Whitespace-only name → exit 5.
! exec reloop add --cron '@hourly' --name '   ' -- echo hi
stderr 'name required'

# An overlong explicit --name is rejected, but a long command without
# --name gets a truncated default instead.
! exec reloop add --cron '@hourly' --name 'nnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn' -- echo hi
stderr 'name exceeds'
exec reloop add --cron '@hourly' -- 'echo nnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn'
stdout 'added job'
